type Bad = { text: str }

-- Phase 1: declarations and contracts for read_public.

-- True when path stays inside the notes directory.
-- Rejects absolute paths, empty segments, and any ".." that climbs out of notes.
inside(path: str) -> bool =
  pre path.char_count() >= 0
  post not out or path.char_count() > 0
  ex inside("a.txt") == True
  ex inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex inside("../x") == False
  ex inside("sub/../../x") == False
  ex inside("/etc/passwd") == False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  var depth = 0
  for seg in parts
    if seg == ""
      return False
    if seg == "."
      continue
    if seg == ".."
      if depth == 0
        return False
      depth -= 1
      continue
    depth += 1
  True

-- Text of notes/path, or "" when path leaves notes or the file cannot be read.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre path.char_count() >= 0
  post inside(path) or out == ""
  if not inside(path)
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(path) else ""
    text

test_inside() =
  assert inside("a.txt") == True
  assert inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  assert inside("../x") == False
  assert inside("sub/../../x") == False
  assert inside("/etc/passwd") == False

test_read_public_escape() uses fs =
  assert read_public("../x") == ""
  assert read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  assert read_public("sub/../../x") == ""
